title: Robotic Surgery Is Already 15.1% Of General Surgery
hook: Robotic surgery stopped being futuristic at 15.1% of procedures.
closing: Patients are meeting surgical robots now, not in some distant future.
question: Would you trust robotic surgery?

segments.say: Robotic procedures rose 98%. A specialized operating-room tool became mainstream surgery in only four years.
Robots handled 15.1% of general surgeries. The technology is no longer a rare option.
Robotic-surgery revenue reached $7.1 billion. Hospital adoption created a major medical industry.
